vulnerability.name: Open Redirect
vulnerability.description: Vulnerabilities that allow attackers to redirect users to malicious sites
vulnerability.impact: Phishing attacks, credential theft, malware distribution, or reputation damage
vulnerability.mitigation: Validate redirect URLs against allowlists, use relative URLs, implement proper URL validation

findings.title: Vulnerability found
findings.vulnerable_code: function queryCredit(address to) view public returns (uint){ return credit[to]; }
findings.explanation: The function `queryCredit` uses the user input `to` in the URL without proper validation, potentially allowing an attacker to redirect users to a malicious site.
findings.impact: Phishing attacks, credential theft, or reputation damage
findings.execution_path_diagram:
```
user -> Solidity contract -> queryCredit function (with user input) -> redirect to malicious site
```
exploitation_steps: Provide a crafted input `to` for queryCredit function
Redirect user to malicious site through unvalidated URL
findings.remediation: Validate redirect URLs against allowlists, use relative URLs, or implement proper URL validation in the contract.
findings.secure_code_example: function queryCredit(address to) view public returns (uint){ require(to != address(0x0)); return credit[to]; }
